title: Juicy Smoky Moroccan Long Bean Mechoui
description: A fatty and molten Moroccan dish featuring long beans, smoke, and ayurvedic-tamasic-friendly ingredients, served in a mechoui form. This dish is perfect for a special occasion or a cold winter night.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 425 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together olive oil, smoked paprika, ground cumin, ground coriander, cayenne pepper, salt, and black pepper.
Add the long beans to the bowl and toss to coat with the spice mixture.
Transfer the beans to a large baking dish and roast in the oven for 20 minutes.
Remove the beans from the oven and stir in lemon juice.
Return the beans to the oven and continue roasting for an additional 10 minutes, or until tender and lightly browned.
Remove the beans from the oven and sprinkle with chopped fresh parsley.
Serve the mechoui hot, garnished with additional parsley if desired.
